title: fix: match QwenGuard pricing to free OVH endpoint
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Qwen3Guard 8B pricing was changed to match its free OVHcloud endpoint, billed per million input and output tokens. Quest + Paid access and model capabilities are unchanged; Paid-only access is a separate change in #16686. Safe/unsafe classification and streaming were verified, with usage recorded without a wallet debit.
